scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by a direct ideal-count induction and mixed-extension injection. One-point-extension parametrization and Fraisse homogeneity are acknowledged prior work; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound need not be the optimal minimum at every fixed pair of size and incomparability count. Finite checks through five points do not replace the unrestricted proof; originality comparisons are best-knowledge and not independent.
source_ids: published:Finite-parameter 1-type counting in the random poset is #P-complete (2026)
title: An incomparability-sensitive lower bound for one-point types of the generic poset
